notes.title: 🛠️ Cursebound 0.31 Update - Patch Notes
notes.content:
[h1]Hey adventurers![/h1]

I've just shipped a fresh update packed with quality-of-life improvements, bug fixes, and some requested features. Here's what's new:

[h2]🎮 Full Gamepad Support[/h2]
[list]
[*] The entire game is now fully playable with a gamepad - from menus to combat. 
[/list]
[h2]🖱️ Camera Sensitivity Settings[/h2]
[list]
[*] You can now adjust both mouse and gamepad camera sensitivity in the options menu. Tune your aim and comfort to your liking.
[/list]

[h2]⚔️ Combat & Controls[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Auto Attack[/b]: Holding the Quick Attack button now triggers continuous strikes.
[*] [b]Rotate While Aiming[/b]: You can now rotate the camera while aiming your bow.
[/list]

[h2]📺 UI & Visuals[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Blur While in Menus[/b]: Background blur added to menus for a more focused and immersive experience.
[*] [b]Blur Persistence Fix[/b]: Fixed an issue where blur would stay active when returning from the main menu to the game.
[/list]

 [h2]🛡️ Gameplay Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]No Damage During Menus[/b]: You’re now invulnerable while navigating menus. No more dying while adjusting settings.
[/list]

I hope this patch smooths out your journey and enhances your experience. Thanks for all the feedback! Keep it coming ♥

- nuuunu
